mini_task_spec:
Using only the tools of the `dispatch` brick (`send`, `queue`, `cancel`, `status`), dispatch one `scan` task per transport-specific server file found in `test-repo/packages/microservices/server/` (files matching `server-*.ts`, excluding `server.ts` and `server-factory.ts`). Each task payload should include `{ "file": "<filename>", "class": "<ExportedClassName>" }` where the class name is the identifier immediately following `export class` in that file. Then call `queue` (status `all`) and report the task entries as `filename:ClassName` pairs, one per line, sorted alphabetically by filename.

The expected answer format is a list of `filename:ClassName` pairs (e.g. `server-grpc.ts:ServerGrpc`), one per line, sorted alphabetically by filename. There are 7 files to cover: `server-grpc.ts`, `server-kafka.ts`, `server-mqtt.ts`, `server-nats.ts`, `server-redis.ts`, `server-rmq.ts`, `server-tcp.ts`.
